footnote: Source: NBS 2025 Statistical Communiqué, Q2 and H1 2026 GDP release (July 16)
notes: Quarterly growth slowed through 2025: 5.4%, 5.2%, 4.8% and 4.5%. It picked up to 5.0% in the first quarter of 2026 and eased to 4.3% in the second, for 4.7% in the first half, inside the 4.5% to 5% range. The second quarter on its own was below the floor. The statistics bureau publishes third-quarter GDP on October 19, so this page stops at the first half. September's official manufacturing PMI was 50.1 and the non-manufacturing business activity index was 50.2, both just above the 50 line between expansion and contraction.
